gaps.prev_text: we've never lab-tested a deity before...
gaps.next_text: Or maybe we should just ignore them

cues.text: Fireworks burst in a starry night sky above a futuristic metropolis. Sleek, curved skyscrapers and large billboards glow with vibrant cyan neon.
A colossal hologram of a large-headed Sophon projects from a central tower. Flying vehicles zip between the gleaming buildings.
Inside, a Sophon works at green holographic screens.
A massive coiled core behind them glows cyan.
The Sophon throws their arms up in a shrug. The core blazes with blinding cyan light, swallowing the room in a brilliant glow. Everything fades to black.

beats.note: Fireworks burst over a futuristic city glowing with cyan neon.
A massive hologram of a Sophon is projected onto a central tower. Flying vehicles zip between the buildings.
Cut to an interior. A Sophon sits at a console with glowing green holographic screens. Behind them is a large, dark, coiled metal structure.
A red warning box flashes on the screen.
The coiled structure behind the Sophon begins to glow with intense cyan light.
The Sophon throws their arms up in a casual shrug as the core blazes with blinding light. Fade to black.
